fees.notes: International student tuition per official IMU programme page https://imu.edu.my/academics/pre-university/foundation-in-science/, fetched 2026-09-18. Official page publishes total tuition RM32,400 (RM10,800/semester); the tuition table does not have a separate international column.

requirements.general: Academic Requirements Pass SPM/O-Level with 5Cs in Mathematics, English, 2 Science subjects** and 1 other subject. **Science subjects: Biology/Chemistry/Physics   English Proficiency Requirements: Malaysian Student: Overall band score of 5.0 (for those who did not obtain a Credit in English at SPM/O-Level) International Student: Overall band score of 5.0
